verificationMethod: Every figure was re-read on its verifiedDate from the gov.uk page named in its `source` (or, when the figure has none, its category's), fetched through the gov.uk content API (https://www.gov.uk/api/content/<path>, User-Agent databutler-curation/1.0; every page HTTP 200). `quote` reproduces the sentence or table row (columns separated by " | ") the value was taken from. `previous` (2025-26) values come from the same page where it prints the earlier year, the DWP "Benefit and pension rates 2026 to 2027" table (column "Rates 2025/26"), HMRC's current-and-previous rates table, the 2025-26 employer rates page, or a UK Government Web Archive (National Archives) capture of the same gov.uk page taken while the 2025-26 figure was in force; none were written from memory. Where no source gave a comparable earlier figure, `previous` is omitted. The figures were first verified 2026-08-31 and all re-verified 2026-10-04 (docs/CURATION.md, verification log).
licence: gov.uk footer on every page cited: "All content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated" (https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/). National Archives web-archive captures of gov.uk pages are reproduced under the same licence.
